Create a new epic at apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-render-engine/epic.md using the epic template. Title: '# Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring'. Goal: Refactor the Flashcards app to introduce a generic RenderEngine mechanism so each card side references a renderEngineId selecting the rendering implementation. Business Value: Enables rich rendering (SVG scores, audio, markdown) via clean extension point without breaking existing themes. Scope: Define RenderEngine interface, implement TextEngine and MarkdownEngine, create engine registry, migrate all 3 existing themes to extended CardSide format, implement precompute lifecycle in SessionScreen. Include Related User Stories section (leave placeholder comment per template). Include Related Sprints section (leave placeholder comment per template). Add frontmatter: ---
title: 'Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring'
---

Create user story US-005 at apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-render-engine/user-stories/us-005-render-engine-interface.md using the us template. Title: '# US-005 — RenderEngine Interface and Registry'. Story: As a developer, I want a generic RenderEngine interface and engine registry so that card sides can be rendered by different implementations selected by ID. Expected Behavior: RenderEngine interface with render(data, target) and optional precompute(data) methods. Engine registry resolves by renderEngineId, defaults to TextEngine. Normalization helper converts plain string to { data, renderEngineId: 'text' }. Acceptance Criteria: RenderEngine interface defined and documented, Engine registry resolves by renderEngineId with TextEngine default, Normalization helper handles plain string → object format, Unit tests for registry and normalization. Related Epic: [Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring](epic-1-render-engine/epic.md). Related Sprints: leave placeholder. Add frontmatter: ---
title: 'US-005 — RenderEngine Interface and Registry'
---

Create user story US-006 at apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-render-engine/user-stories/us-006-text-markdown-engines.md using the us template. Title: '# US-006 — TextEngine and MarkdownEngine Implementations'. Story: As a learner, I want flashcard content to render correctly whether it is plain text or markdown so that I can study different types of content. Expected Behavior: TextEngine renders plain text into the target HTMLElement. MarkdownEngine converts markdown to HTML and renders into the target. Both implement the RenderEngine interface. Neither implements precompute — flip is always instant. Acceptance Criteria: TextEngine implemented and handles plain text, MarkdownEngine implemented and handles markdown-to-HTML, Both wired to engine registry ('text' and 'markdown' IDs), All existing tests pass without modification. Related Epic: [Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring](epic-1-render-engine/epic.md). Related Sprints: leave placeholder. Add frontmatter: ---
title: 'US-006 — TextEngine and MarkdownEngine Implementations'
---

Create user story US-007 at apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-render-engine/user-stories/us-007-session-preload.md using the us template. Title: '# US-007 — SessionScreen Precompute Lifecycle'. Story: As a learner, I want the back side of a card to be precomputed while I read the question so that the flip is instant when I tap. Expected Behavior: SessionScreen calls engine.precompute?.(back.data) immediately after question display. If precompute is still running when user taps to flip, SessionScreen waits for completion before flipping. TextEngine and MarkdownEngine do NOT implement precompute — flip is always instant. The mechanism must benefit future engines automatically. Acceptance Criteria: SessionScreen calls precompute immediately after question display, SessionScreen waits for precompute completion before flipping if still running, Precompute strategy is universal — applies to all engines, Existing tests pass without modification. Related Epic: [Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring](epic-1-render-engine/epic.md). Related Sprints: leave placeholder. Add frontmatter: ---
title: 'US-007 — SessionScreen Precompute Lifecycle'
---

Create user story US-008 at apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-render-engine/user-stories/us-008-dataset-migration.md using the us template. Title: '# US-008 — Dataset Migration to Extended CardSide Format'. Story: As a developer, I want all existing themes to adopt explicit renderEngineId per side so that the new rendering architecture works with zero visual regression. Expected Behavior: All 3 existing themes migrate to extended CardSide format: { front: { data: '...', renderEngineId: 'text' }, back: { data: '...', renderEngineId: 'text' } }. Conjugaisons back side uses 'markdown' engine for multiline content. Plain string format remains supported (backward compatible). SessionScreen and FlashcardDisplay wired to use resolved engine. Acceptance Criteria: All 3 existing themes migrated to extended CardSide format, Conjugaisons back side uses markdown engine, Plain string format remains backward compatible, All existing tests pass without modification, Build passes. Related Epic: [Epic 1 — RenderEngine Refactoring](epic-1-render-engine/epic.md). Related Sprints: leave placeholder. Add frontmatter: ---
title: 'US-008 — Dataset Migration to Extended CardSide Format'
---
